What to understand at MT11

Region/difficulty record
A highscore for one specific region and difficulty. Different difficulties in one region create separate records.
Wave Horizon
Software whose benefits depend on broader Era progress. The supplied strategy develops Era records across multiple region/difficulty combinations.
Infinity 1
The next progression scale reached after the late-Era milestone. Its combat changes are introduced in the MT12 guide.

What you are working toward

  • Work toward Era 100,000,000,000 / the first Infinity milestone and confirm the current MT12 checklist.
  • Improve record coverage and acceleration while keeping the established Era combat solution intact.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an editorial synthesis of the supplied community research. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Secure the Era combat foundation

    Before a long push, verify that your divisors and disables work on the chosen region. Speed software cannot compensate for a blueprint that stops killing or dies when the run reaches its next elemental obstacle. [S08]

  2. Create Era records on more combinations

    Reach Era 1 on additional regions and difficulties that you can handle. The older community route aims toward 90 combinations, from 15 regions times six difficulties. Treat this as an acceleration project rather than a statement that all 90 are mandatory to promote. [S07] [S10] [S12]

  3. Use Wave Horizon with the other unlocked tools

    Review Wave Horizon, Wave Marathon and your available Era software. Make sure the relevant research is complete, then inspect how these tools interact with your records. The value of broader coverage is that it improves the progress of future runs, not just the score on the current one. [S07] [S10]

  4. Separate preparation from the final push

    Older community strategies build acceleration before enabling the strongest Era-skipping tools. Try this only with an understood software setup and watch the effect. Do not treat a historical time or acceleration target as a verified current requirement. [S10] [S12]

  5. Register Infinity and finish the promotion

    Once the milestone is reached, check Headquarters rather than assuming the game has completed all module requirements for you. After MT12, inspect the newly unlocked Infinity Workshop before pushing farther with the old blueprint. [S02] [S09]

If you are stuck

The tower is safe but the ETA is enormous

Review software, research and cross-map record coverage. This stage often has a progression-speed bottleneck rather than a damage bottleneck.

An imported old blueprint or timer does not work

Check module availability, upgraded tiers and patch changes. The linked older routes provide ideas, not guarantees for a current save.

Ready to move on?

  • The first Infinity milestone is recorded.
  • All other MT12 objectives are complete.
After the promotion

Infinity enemies introduce a different combat problem. Learn the new modules and fragment systems before assuming an Era blueprint can continue unchanged. [S02] [S07] [S09]
